overview.description: The ProShares Ultra Utilities (UPW) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Utilities Select Sector index. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure to a market cap-weighted index of S&P 500 utilities stocks. UPW was launched on Jan 30, 2007 and is issued by ProShares.
